title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Invasion Risk Scoring in Tru-Cut Biopsies of Ductal Carcinoma in Situ; Predictive Role of Estrogen Receptor and HER2 Expression.
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AI辅助评分预测导管原位癌活检中的浸润风险，关注ER/HER2表达，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Invasion can be detected in up to 50% of excision specimens in cases diagnosed with ductal carcinoma in-situ (DCIS) in tru-cut biopsies. The predicting of invasion is critical for managing the treatment. The objective of this study was to ascertain the predictive role of histological characteristics and estrogen receptor (ER) and HER2 expression of DCIS with respect to invasion and to create an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted invasion risk scoring. MATERIAL AND METHODS: A total of 140 tru-cut biopsies with DCIS were included. We evaluated the predominant structural pattern, nuclear grade, presence of comedonecrosis, and ER/HER2 expressions and their relationship with invasion upstage. Based on the results, an invasion risk scoring system was created using OpenAI-ChatGPT 5.2. RESULTS: Of the 140 cases, 70 (50%) were high-grade (DCIS-3), 49 (35%) were intermediate-grade (DCIS-2), and 21 (15%) were low-grade (DCIS-1). DCIS-1 and DCIS-2 showed significant association with a cribriform pattern, and DCIS-3 showed with a solid pattern. When the results were compared with those of the final specimens, invasion upstaging occurred in 9.5% of DCIS-1, 38.7% of DCIS-2, and 52.8% of DCIS-3 cases. A solid pattern, high nuclear grade, comedonecrosis, and ER-/HER2- profile showed high correlation with invasion. In AI-assisted risk scoring, DCIS cases were divided into three groups: low, medium, and high risk. The invasion upstaging rates in these groups were 11.44%, 28.97%, and 64.19%, respectively. CONCLUSION: DCIS with high nuclear grade, comedonecrosis, a solid pattern, and the ER-/HER2+ or ER-/HER2- immunoprofile should be considered high risk for invasion. They should be approached as invasive tumors and evaluated in terms of lymph node staging and neoadjuvant treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：在tru-cut活检诊断为导管原位癌（DCIS）的病例中，高达50%的切除标本可检测到浸润。预测浸润对于治疗管理至关重要。本研究旨在确定DCIS的组织学特征及雌激素受体（ER）和HER2表达对浸润的预测作用，并创建人工智能（AI）辅助的浸润风险评分。材料与方法：共纳入140例DCIS的tru-cut活检。我们评估了主要结构模式、核分级、粉刺样坏死存在情况以及ER/HER2表达及其与浸润升级的关系。基于结果，使用OpenAI-ChatGPT 5.2创建了浸润风险评分系统。结果：在140例中，70例（50%）为高级别（DCIS-3），49例（35%）为中级别（DCIS-2），21例（15%）为低级别（DCIS-1）。DCIS-1和DCIS-2与筛状模式显著相关，而DCIS-3与实性模式显著相关。当结果与最终标本比较时，浸润升级发生在DCIS-1的9.5%、DCIS-2的38.7%和DCIS-3的52.8%病例中。实性模式、高核分级、粉刺样坏死以及ER-/HER2-表型与浸润高度相关。在AI辅助风险评分中，DCIS病例被分为三组：低风险、中风险和高风险。这些组的浸润升级率分别为11.44%、28.97%和64.19%。结论：具有高核分级、粉刺样坏死、实性模式以及ER-/HER2+或ER-/HER2-免疫表型的DCIS应被视为浸润高风险。应将其作为浸润性肿瘤处理，并评估淋巴结分期和新辅助治疗。
